What is our travel reimbursement policy for domestic flights?

result.content: Employees traveling on company business are authorized for economy class commercial domestic flights booked at least 14 days in advance. Meals are reimbursed up to $75 USD per diem with valid itemized receipts. Ground transit via Uber/Lyft is covered for airport transfers and client meetings.
